title: 美联储主席凯文·沃什：通胀风险已下降市场解读偏鹰
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: When we met two weeks ago, I think the way we, as a committee, described the labor side of the mandators, we said labor markets are steady.
segments.zh: 两周前开会时，委员会认为劳动力市场稳定。

segments.en: We said the demand side of the economy was solid.
And we said the supply side of the economy, especially CapEx and productivity.
segments.zh: 供给侧，尤其是资本支出和生产率，表现强劲。

segments.en: Again, this is before we see the fruits of AI. We said that was strong.
segments.zh: 这是在AI成果显现之前，我们就认为强劲。

segments.en: I don't want to sound like a Wall Street newsletter and update that with recent events because we follow trends.
segments.zh: 我不想像华尔街简报那样，用近期事件更新观点，我们关注趋势。

segments.en: And, you know, I'll reinforce something that President Lagarde just said.
segments.zh: 我要重申拉加德行长的话。

segments.en: We're on the price stability business. That might not be our only business.
segments.zh: 我们的核心任务是物价稳定，尽管不是唯一任务。

segments.en: But if there was a common thing I heard over the last couple of days, it was open-mindedness on these questions of AI.
segments.zh: 过去几天我听到的共同点是，对AI问题持开放态度。

segments.en: Open-mindedness on productivity. But we've all looked around and we've seen the prices are too high and I don't think I'm the only one on this stage
segments.zh: 对生产率也持开放态度。但我们都看到物价过高，我相信不止我一人。

segments.en: that's recommitted to deliver price stability. So the market was right to interpret your first news conference as hawkish?
segments.zh: 重新承诺实现物价稳定。所以市场认为你的首次记者会偏鹰派是正确的？

segments.en: Nice try. Yeah, I've just got an advice from a senior statesman on this group not to do that.
segments.zh: 问得好。有位资深政要建议我不要那样做。

segments.en: But I'll say this, expectations of inflation over the first four weeks of this period,
segments.zh: 但我要说，过去四周的通胀预期已经下降。

segments.en: they've come down, inflation risks have come down.
Again, in our business, we don't want to over-determine things.
segments.zh: 再说一次，我们这一行不想过度解读。
